Explain how a VPN works in simple words
2:35 AM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and another computer on the internet, and everything you send goes through it scrambled.

Without one, your internet provider and the Wi-Fi network you use can see which sites you visit. With one, your device locks your traffic and sends it to the VPN company's computer. That computer unlocks it and talks to the website for you. The website sees the VPN's address instead of yours, and your provider only sees scrambled data going to the VPN.

It helps on public Wi-Fi and hides your location from websites. It does not make you anonymous, because the VPN company can still see your activity, so pick one you trust.
